Based on the provided abstract, the study is a review article summarizing the strengths and limitations of conventional strategies and novel microfluidic methods for extracellular vesicle (EV) isolation, presenting commercially available isolation techniques and kits, and assessing the global market demand. 

None of the candidate hypotheses (which propose specific novel integrated experimental systems combining deep learning, acoustofluidics, surface plasmon resonance imaging (SPRi), or size-exclusion chromatography (SEC) adaptive frameworks) are supported by or tested in this review.

CHOICE: NONE
